definition: a line of people following one after another
description: A military band in black ceremonial uniforms with red-striped trousers and peaked caps moves down a city street in formation, legs swinging up high in unison and white-gloved arms swinging, brass instruments raised. An officer with a sword strides at the front. Behind steel barriers a dense crowd films and waves Indian flags. The shot then cuts to a wide view down a flag-lined avenue where a huge column of uniformed ranks stretches into the distance, watched by a grandfather holding a child in the foreground.

de.answer: Die Kapelle marschiert die Straße entlang.
de.question: Was macht die Kapelle?

es.answer: La banda está desfilando por la calle.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la banda?
